t: The Weak Automata core is turtle upgrade, that allow to transform turtle into powerful automata!
虚弱自动机核心是一种海龟升级，可将海龟转变为强大的自动机！

It provides several ability for turtles.$(li)Digging block with tool;$(li)Click on block with item or empty hand;$(li)Suck item around, all or specific;$(li)Detect items around;$(li)Detect block or turtle in line of view;$(li)Charge turtle with RF item inside inventory
它为海龟提供多项能力：$(li)使用工具挖掘方块；$(li)手持物品或空手点击方块；$(li)吸取周围物品（全部或特定种类）；$(li)探测周围物品；$(li)探测视线范围内的方块或海龟；$(li)利用物品栏内的RF物品为海龟充能

But weak core is only a start of metaphysics research! Empty construct ready to accept soul fragments of mobs. Seems, you need to try to feed different mobs to soul to receive advanced variants.$(li)$(l:metaphysics/end_automata_core)End Automata core$(li)$(l:metaphysics/husbandry_automata_core)Husbandry Automata core
但虚弱核心仅仅是形而上学研究的起点！空置的构造体正等待接纳生物的灵魂碎片。看来你需要尝试喂养不同生物，以获取进阶变体。$(li)$(l:metaphysics/end_automata_core)末地自动机核心$(li)$(l:metaphysics/husbandry_automata_core)农牧业自动机核心
